sentences.text:
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.32 of 2021,
under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, police station Naseerpur, District Firozabad with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: The first information report was lodged against applicant and one unknown person, alleging that on 28.01.2021, the applicant has enticed away her minor daughter.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Alleged incident has been shown of 28.01.2021 but first information report has been lodged on 24.02.2021.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated her age as 19 years and she has stated that she has gone with applicant-accused to Mathura with her Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74568458/
1 own free will and they have married with each other and she is having pregnancy of two months and she wants to go with applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submitted that statement of victim has already been recorded before the Trial Court, wherein, she has stated that she herself has left her home and went to applicant-accused and that applicant has not committed any rape upon her.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: She did not support prosecution version and she was declared hostile.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It was also pointed out that in her cross examination, she has inter-alia stated that later on she has married with applicant-accused and out of that marriage, she has one child and that she is still living with applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that in view of statement of victim, no useful purpose would be served to keep the applicant in jail.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It was pointed out that victim herself has stated her age as 19 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Lastly, it has been submitted that the applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 24.09.2021, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Let the applicant-accused Mahaveer involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant-accused shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The applicant-accused shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. The applicant-accused shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. The applicant-accused shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant-accused in accordance with law.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, the learned A.G.A. could not dislodge the factual and legal submissions urged by the learned counsel for applicant with reference to the record at this stage.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Having heard, the learned counsel for applicant-appellant the learned A.G.A. for State, upon perusal of record, evidence, complicity of applicant-appellant and accusations made coupled with the fact that the maximum sentence awarded to the applicant is 8 years.

sentences.text: Applicant-appellant has already been under incarceration for little more than 11 months.

sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: The medical evidence not supporting the prosecution story as unfolded in the deposition of the prosecutrix herself.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: The recital contained at page 17 of the paper book which prima facie goes to show that pre-existing enmity was there in between the applicant-appellant and the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: In the light of above, the statement of the prosecutrix as noted by the Court below that something was given by the applicant to the prosecutrix as "Prashad" and was consumed by her neither appears to be credible nor reliable.

Author: Rajeev Misra

opennyai_summary.final__facts: Accordingly, applicant-appellant has filed aforementioned application for bail seeking his enlargement on bail during the pendency of appeal.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
Applicant-applicant has been convicted and sentenced under Section 376 I.P.C. but the maximum sentence awarded to the applicant-appellant is 8 years.
Applicant-appellant has been convicted and sentenced for an offence punishable under Section 376 I.P.C.
Applicant-appellant is guilty of dislodging the modesty of the prosecutrix by committing sexual assault upon her.
Having heard, the learned counsel for applicant-appellant the learned A.G.A. for State, upon perusal of record, evidence, complicity of applicant-appellant and accusations made coupled with the fact that the maximum sentence awarded to the applicant is 8 years.
Applicant-appellant has already been under incarceration for little more than 11 months.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
As such, offence complained of is not private in nature but a crime against the society.
In fact the same falls in the category of moral turpitude.
The period of incarceration undergone by applicant-appellant is not so sufficient so as to enlarge the applicant-appellant on bail.
Even otherwise, in view of nature of the offence committed by applicant-appellant interest of justice shall be served in case the appeal itself is heard on merits by Mahaveer vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198517426/
2 fixing a short date rather than deciding the bail matter.
There is no likelihood of the appeal being heard in near future on account of heavy pendency of appeals before this Court.
In the light of above, the statement of the prosecutrix as noted by the Court below that something was given by the applicant to the prosecutrix as "Prashad" and was consumed by her neither appears to be credible nor reliable.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The clean antecedents of the applicant-appellant inasmuch as he has no criminal history to his credit except present one but without making any comment on the merits of the appeal, applicant-appellant has made out a case for bail.
Let the applicant-appellant Mahaveer, be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
However, the applicant-appellant shall deposit the entire amount of fine awarded by court below within a period of one month from today failing which the bail granted to applicant-appellant shall stand cancelled and he shall be taken into custody to serve out the sentence awarded to him.
